header.title: SwipeToDismiss
header.description: Drag-to-dismiss for toasts, alerts, and list rows. Pointer drag on the host (mouse or touch); release past `threshold` or with a flick to fly out. `direction` is the gesture axis; `dismissDirection` sets which sign commits and the exit trajectory (`both` follows the swipe). `rubberband` (default true) resists drags against a locked edge. `onSwipeStart` / `onSwipeMove` / `onSwipeCancel` track the gesture. Restore / `isIn={true}` slides the item back in from the dismiss edge. `direction="horizontal"` (default) keeps vertical scrolling (`touch-action: pan-y`). Clicks on inner buttons still work — the gesture starts after 8px. `onDismiss` fires on a committed swipe so the parent can set `isIn={false}` or remove the item. Not for HTML `table` / `tr`.

header.title: SwipeToDismiss API
header.description: Reference for props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types for `SwipeToDismiss`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for direction, rubberband, markSelected, and list rows.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import from `@gem-org/gemsitions/swipe-to-dismiss` with its `swipe-to-dismiss.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> and forwards them to the root div, or to the child with asChild. The gesture is pointer on the host; clicks on inner buttons still work (8px slop). Do not use table / tr.

items.gesture: Swipe dismiss should not be the only way to close or remove an item. Offer an equivalent control (button).
items.scroll: With direction="horizontal" the host uses touch-action: pan-y so vertical scroll still works. Vertical axes use pan-x.
items.dismiss: onDismiss fires on a committed swipe. Update presence there (isIn={false} or remove the item). Programmatic isIn={false} does not call onDismiss.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the host snaps to the final state with no interpolation.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion keeps the animation and adds gemst-ignore-reduced-motion. Only if motion is essential.
items.host: Pick a host with the right semantics (toast, alert, row). The markSelected ring is decorative — it does not replace focus or real selection.
items.asChild: With asChild, the child receives pointer handlers and styles. Use an element that can be interactive.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Written on the host from phase and drag.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global gemsitions variables the CSS uses as defaults.

state.title: State
state.description: How the gesture is turned off.

items.asChild: Applies classes, styles, and ref to the single child. That child is the gesture host.
items.isIn: `true` (default) plays enter and stays mounted; `false` plays exit and unmounts when done.
items.direction: Gesture axis. `horizontal` (default) dismisses left/right and keeps vertical scrolling; `vertical` does the inverse. A single edge (`left` / `right` / `up` / `down`) only accepts that sign.
items.dismissDirection: Exit trajectory and which sign commits. `both` (default) follows the swipe; a single edge only commits that sign and always exits that way.
items.rubberband: `true` (default) resists drag against a locked edge. `false` hard-clamps to 0.
items.threshold: Fraction of host size that counts as dismiss (0–1). Default `0.35`.
items.velocityThreshold: Flick speed in px/ms that dismisses even below threshold. Default `0.5`.
items.markSelected: Shows a selection ring on hover (and while dragging).
items.unmountOnExit: Unmounts immediately on dismiss (skips exit motion).
items.duration: Duration. With `{ enter, exit }`, enter = restore; exit = dismiss.
items.delay: Wait before programmatic enter/exit. Drag always starts immediately.
items.easing: Token, timing function, or `{ enter, exit }`. Settle uses enter; dismiss uses exit.
items.isDisabled: Disables the gesture and snaps presence.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only if essential.
items.onDismiss: When a swipe crosses the threshold (or a flick). Update presence here. Programmatic `isIn={false}` does not call this.
items.onSwipeStart: When the drag axis locks (after the 8px slop).
items.onSwipeCancel: When the drag ends without committing and the host settles back.
items.onSwipe: When the host is shown (`isIn` true).
items.outSwipe: When it dismisses, disables, or unmounts.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Combined with `--gemst-swipe-*`.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
